claim_boundary: This matrix is the experiment contract, not a result. A hypothesis is not promoted until its validation artifact and locked benchmark artifact both exist, use non-oracle prompts, and beat the declared control on identical row identities.
holdout_policy: CoSQL dev 100 is a locked proxy benchmark, but not a pristine scientific holdout because earlier prompt and evidence iteration inspected it. Treat it as a reproducible proxy gate. Hosted and BIRD-Interact transfer rows remain the clean external holdout for broad claims.

hypotheses.next_gpu_run: Train a small direct-SQL adapter on train rows, choose settings on smoke validation, then evaluate once on the locked proxy.
hypotheses.promotion_gate: Fine-tuned direct-SQL adapter beats base model on the locked proxy with matching input hash, scorer hash, row count, and non-oracle prompts.

hypotheses.next_gpu_run: Train or prompt a non-oracle planner on train/validation rows, freeze the planner, then evaluate generated SQL against direct SQL on locked rows.
hypotheses.promotion_gate: Predicted-planner SQL beats the direct-SQL arm on identical locked proxy rows, while planner table/column/projection metrics improve on validation.

hypotheses.next_gpu_run: Train a semantic-target adapter and compare it to direct SQL on the same validation rows before using the locked proxy.
hypotheses.promotion_gate: Semantic value-retrieval prompts or adapter beat direct SQL on identical rows, with value-index provenance recorded in the comparison manifest.

hypotheses.next_gpu_run: Train separate metric-DSL and direct-SQL fixture adapters, generate held validation predictions, then run the compiled-SQL comparison.
hypotheses.promotion_gate: Metric DSL parses, preserves MEASURE(), compiles, and beats direct SQL on matching metric-heavy fixtures.

hypotheses.next_gpu_run: Train recovery and direct-control adapters, then compare generated-history rollout against teacher-forced and direct-control manifests.
hypotheses.promotion_gate: Recovery adapter beats direct-SQL control under generated-history rollout, not teacher-forced history.

hypotheses.next_gpu_run: Do not run this until at least one local method beats direct SQL on locked proxy rows.
hypotheses.promotion_gate: Local and hosted runs share inputs, scorer, oracle boundary, latency, and cost accounting, then transfer to BIRD-Interact or equivalent interactive rows.
